Confirmed for the admindocs display-name regression established by the thread and code, not for a newly introduced missing-__module__ crash. At baa5d52b, qualname() rejects names containing <locals>; get_view_name() then replaces a closure name such as __main__.make_view.<locals>.inner with __main__.function. An isolated check reproduced this loss; a local view_class also raises ValueError instead of returning its display name. The prior implementation and later PR head e715dcb3 both preserve these names, matching the author's explanation and revert. The supplied author_resolution_commit_sha equals the defective reviewed revision and must not be treated as the fixing commit. Source: https://github.com/django/django/pull/21875#discussion_r3933613984

adjudication_notes: AI evidence review; human sign-off pending. Confirmed input-handling regression at 3d0986ba. The new unconditional empty-subelement-list guard makes subelements([], []) and subelements({}, []) raise AnsibleFilterError although both returned [] previously. Isolated checks against the reviewed source, PR base, and later head fb594e97 reproduced the regression and verified that the final implementation again returns []. Both the collection and accessor list must be empty for these reproducers; an empty collection with a nonempty accessor still succeeds. The intended fix for an unbound-variable error on other inputs does not require rejecting these successful empty-input cases. Source: https://github.com/ansible/ansible/pull/87412#discussion_r3778118024
human_comment: If element_list is empty it passed before, and fails now.

adjudication_notes: AI evidence review; human sign-off pending. Confirmed incorrect diagnostic content at d8ae5096. TokenError.args[0] is the tokenizer's explanation, but the new handler displays it as the source line and places a source-column caret beneath it; the actual faulty source is absent. A focused check of the unchanged handler with an injected TokenError reproduced this incorrect display. The later PR head 3e181f25 instead extracts src_txt.splitlines()[lineno - 1], with an out-of-range fallback, and displays the TokenError explanation separately; the same focused check shows the source line restored. The confirmation is for substituting error text for source code, not merely a preference for the final-line wording. This was an isolated handler check, not a full Black test suite. Source: https://github.com/psf/black/pull/5068#discussion_r3006479284
